title: Extract Nakagin Kit Compat Into Board Fixture
description: Temporary script extracts kindCompatibility from metabolism.kit.compose.json into nakagin board fixture meta; no generator change.
summary: Ticket script `extract-nakagin-kit-compat.script.ts` reads the Nakagin Capsule Tower family from `assets/fixtures/metabolism.kit.compose.json`, emits deduped handle-level `BoardKindCompatEntry` rows (`compose.metabolism.light.handle.<portId>`, `bidirectional: true`, `specificity: handle`; 14 pairs) to `kind-compatibility.extracted.json`, and `--write-board` merges them into `.storybook/fixtures/nakagin-capsule-tower.board.json` as `meta.kindCompatibility`. Manually verified sample kit ports (e.g. door capsule east `4ac2be8fc645` ↔ door tambour east `50266f6860b8`) match the fixture. Added `boardFixtureMetaKindCompatibility` in `elements/client/lib/board/index.ts` and passed `kindCompatibility` from the fixture on `NakaginCapsuleTowerFlatSelection` in `Board.stories.tsx`. Ran `bun run nx run @elements/board:test` (Rust, Vitest, Playwright) successfully.
